'''Rhilithan''' was a lifeless [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Indrexu sector/Legends|Indrexu sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
This world was located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. It was used as a waypoint for the transport ships that were working for [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera|Mika the Hutt]], transporting spice to and from [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] following the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>

*[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]
